items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: I just wondered if you know Punch played with him too a while. Yeah, I don't remember, but I know Punch from racing, you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. Zeb. And I can't think of his... Who was the coronet? What's that fellow's name? Didn't he have a brother? Oh, Mutt.

I just wondered if you know Punch played with him too a while. Yeah, I don't remember, but I know Punch from racing, you know. Punch is a player in racing. That's why he met me with Gabriel, see? Well you knew Punch out there in the country. Oh yeah, oh yeah. Yeah, sure.
